arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
translation: “And those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our paths. And truly, God is with the doers of good.”

shia.label: Shia emphasis
shia.body: Shia tafsir reads the plural ‘paths’ as layered struggle — against the enemy, against Satan, deepest against the self — the effort itself the first guidance.

sunni.label: Sunni emphasis
sunni.body: Sunni tafsir reads striving in God’s cause — the Prophet, his companions, and all who follow — answered with steadfast guidance along His straight path.

voiceover.hook: One verse makes a promise: if you keep struggling, God will guide you. Two of Islam's great traditions read that promise a little differently.
voiceover.payoff: Both make the same promise — strive, and you will be guided. For the Shia, those paths turn inward, deepest against the self; for the Sunni, straight along God's one road to Him.
voiceover.question: Which of these two readings resonates with you
